annotations.title: Bind a Yandex Webmaster host to a project

description: Link (or repoint) a project's Yandex Webmaster host. `hostId` is re-validated against the caller's LIVE host list on every call.

hostId.description: Yandex's own composite protocol:domain:port host id, taken verbatim from list_yandex_hosts.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: set_yandex_host
